scene yuusroom
I wake up to the taste of pencil lead as I must have absentmindedly fallen asleep while writing out my career sheet last night.
That happens sometimes — particularly when certain angles line up perfectly (or imperfectly based on whether or not you enjoy the taste of pencil lead).
I’m not sure what I want to be just yet, but I’m leaning toward an astronaut or something similar so I can get back at the aliens who killed Saki’s parents.
I imagine they’re much better at hand-to-hand combat than me. But if there is anything I have learned from anime, it’s that willpower always trumps actual skill.
Until it doesn’t, at least. But Saki can tell you more about that than I can.
: Right, Saki?
show sakisurprised
: Hm? Did you say something?
: Why did you put this pencil in my mouth?
: I didn’t put any pencil in your mouth. Why would I put a pencil in your mouth?
She raises a good point. Saki has never inserted any sort of writing utensil into my mouth before — at least to my knowledge.
But that just means she could and then probably get away with it since I’m so forgiving and easygoing.
: Okay, you’re off the hook for now. But I’ll be keeping an eye on you, you hear me?
show sakiangry
: You need to stop stalling and fill out your career sheet. We only have one more day before we have to turn it in.
: Am I barred from having any sort of career for the rest of my life if I don’t meet the deadline?
: Yes. You’ll receive a mark on your permanent record that will follow you for the rest of your life before ending up as a janitor or some other job no one else wants to do.
: I think that’s probably offensive to janitors.
: Well, you’ll know for sure in five years when you are one.
: I’m just going to write “husband” on mine. Then, you can write “wife” on yours and we can match.
show sakiembarrassed
: But...I already wrote that I want to be a teacher...
: Well, darn. Guess that just means I’ll have to find another bride. Do you think Miu still-
show sakiangry
: Hmph!
: Oh, right. You get jealous when I talk about her.
: I do not.
: Then what was the “hmph” for?
: I was just clearing my throat. That was a throat-clearing noise.
: Is there pencil lead stuck in yours as well?
: That’s it. You’re clearly helpless without me, so I’m just going to fill out your career sheet on my own.
: Use a pen. The ink doesn’t taste as bad.
Saki and I are in love, I think.
She’s the first thing that pops into my mind after I greet the world each morning, and the last thing on it just after wishing goodnight to Josh.
scene black
We’ll probably start a family one day. That’s what you’re supposed to do when you’re in love, you know.
And with my school life on the verge of ending once and for all, maybe it will be sooner rather than later?
I say, not having even experienced my first kiss yet.
Saki wants to try, but she’s hesitant because she doesn’t have a sweet tooth.
I guess it doesn’t matter, though.
It’s only a matter of time until life changes for good.
And when it does-
Maybe all these cavities will start to go away.
I’ve never held a baby before.
scene lr2_day
: I’m off! I’ll be back in a few hours, okay?
: Are you sure you’re ready?
: Nope! But there’s only one way to find out and that’s by facing things head-on!
: Ami-
: Save it for later, Dad! Gotta go!
Ami’s been doing better lately.
The camping trip probably helped in some way.
Either that or the fact that being able to refer to me as “Dad” now has lifted off some of the weight that’s been keeping her grounded all these years.
But what that means is now I have to worry about her floating away.
I tied a leash around her so that doesn’t happen.
A symbolic one, if you will. Not an actual leash, despite how greatly she’d prefer such a thing.
I promised I’d make this house more of a home.
But, of course, I conveniently left out the detail where doing such a thing would require the assistance of another woman who could function as a mother figure for her.
Which isn’t to say you can’t have a home with one parent. It’s just impossible to do such a thing when that one parent is me as I don’t even know how to take care of myself.
But I’m trying.
Which means that, today...I am going to clean the house.
Or not.
: Hello? Is anyone home?
: ...Yasu?
: Can you spare a moment to talk about our lord and savior?
: Yeah. Definitely Yasu.
scene black
Unsure of what she’s doing here or...how she even found my house in the first place, I abandon my goal of lightening Ami’s load and hope that spiteful gravity does all of the work for me.
Especially since there’s no way I’m comfortable with letting Yasu roam around my neighborhood when I know how easily she gets lost.
But I guess we’re all prone to getting “lost” in our own ways. And I’m sure I’d prefer hers to whatever I’ve been doing ever since She turned into meat.
scene yasufliers1
It must be nice believing in something that isn’t there.

God not actually existing means that it or It can’t ever leave you when those who are tangible actually can, and it’s that sort of security that I think would make it easier to get out of bed each morning.
Now, every time I step outside of my house, I do nothing but wonder which part of me I’ll lose along the way.
I’m just a lamb, after all.
But it appears my shepherd has come to corral me.
: What lives not in the shadows thrives in the sun.
: And “good morning” to you as well.
: I didn’t know you lived here.
: And I didn’t know you were a door-to-door salesman now.
scene yasufliers2
: I am no salesman, just a merchant of salvation.
: I feel like that line is being underutilized by the others working in your field.
: There are no others. But that is why I appear before you today in all of my unwantedness.
: Can you spare a moment to talk about our lord and-
: Your lord. You already know I don’t believe in that stuff.
scene yasufliers3
: But I also know that you have seen such “stuff,” which is what makes your acceptance all but inevitable once the fear is expelled from your vessel.
: Are you really handing out fliers right now?
scene yasufliers4
: Touka suggested that it would be a good idea...but no one is opening the door for me.
: Yeah, that’ll happen. The only reason I answered in the first place was because I recognized your voice. And I guess also because I hate cleaning.
scene yasufliers5
: That fills me with an unbearable sadness as my mission is to help you clean your soul...
: I’m surprised you’re making this a mission in the first place since I thought your church was closed off to anyone who isn’t “chosen.”
scene yasufliers6
: It is true that His doors remain locked to those without keys in their hearts. But the weakening of His whispers has forced my hand into turning these heretic tides into ones that we can wade in.
: So please, do me the favor of cutting your flesh on the shells of truth we can pluck from the sands of this city.
: So...hand out fliers with you?
: Help deliver righteousness and love to those who need it most.
: So...everyone who isn’t already one of “His” followers?
: Yes.
: So just everyone.
scene yasufliers7
: The truth is so visible, yet so blinding all at once. It is no wonder most can’t help but shield their eyes from the glow of salvation...
I mean...I guess I can help her out?
But I’m also not sure if I should since I feel like all it would do is get her hopes up that someone might actually take her seriously when she tells them she can hear the voice of God.
meanwhile, akira “sad boy” arakawa converses with a mysterious voice inside HIS sorrow-filled head and pretends he doesn’t hear shit
scene yasufliers8
I hear you loud and clear.
rad, then invite her inside and give her some of that sweet loving you’re going to give to her friend with the massive honkers
No thanks. Touka would kill me and I don’t see Yasu that way.
LIAR. YOU SEE EVERY TEENAGE COCK-POCKET THAT WAY. plus, you already made her cum once and it was craaaaaaaazy
: What is it you hear, Sensei?
: What?
: Is it the whispers of the world? The stirring of the cicadas? Or perhaps the hum of an undying entity concealed beneath this colossal bed of worms?
: Would you believe me if I told you the nagging yet sarcastic disembodied voice of a supernatural being?
your mom is a nagging disembodied voice. i’m more like a wingman who’s here to help you get your dick wet.
: Your blood is louder all of a sudden.
yeah cause it’s all rushing to his big fat wiener.
: Okay. Sure. I’ll help you hand out fliers, Yasu. Just as long as you promise to stop asking me about what I’m hearing so I can go back to pretending it isn’t there.
scene yasufliers9

: Really? You’ll assist in the divine reassurance that the path of light will never fully darken, even in the coldest of winters?! And lift up His word so that all may gaze on in admiration and jubilance?!
: I will help you hand out fliers.
scene yasufliers10
: That is how it begins...but it ends with you on a throne of flesh, bathed in the residue of a job well done as He swallows the gifts you’ve provided.
scene yasufliers11
: Then, as the passerby’s gaze locks on the mountain of bodies you have both conquered and saved, they will be forced to prostrate before Him and ascend the throne as well!
: Covered in the sweetest of all nectars, we’ll finally know what it means to be touched by the hand of God! We’ll finally know how it feels to-
: Okay, never mind. I’m going back inside.
scene yasufliers12
: I apologize...I got a little too excited.
: I’m just glad you started ranting about “the sweetest nectar” in front of me and not some other guy who hasn’t figured out you’re not all there yet.
: Not all where?
scene black
: Come on. There’s a small market nearby that you can probably hand some fliers out at.
: Huh? But there are houses here that-
: Don’t bother my neighbors, please. There’s no way they haven’t noticed the mass amount of teenage girls coming over to my house all the time and I don’t want them to think you’re one of mine.
scene yasufliers13
: I suppose that would be problematic as I am one of His and His only.
: I think it’d be a little more problematic on my end, but you do you.
: This market — does it sell or trade unholy relics that may interfere with the message I am to deliver?
: Depends. Are tomatoes unholy relics?
scene yasufliers14
: Yes.
: Really?
scene yasufliers15
: No.
: Did Touka teach you what jokes are? Because they normally involve a little more than just lying to someone.
: Lying is a sin punishable by the immediate removal of your shortest fingernail.
: What rule do I need to break before the longest one is removed?
: Nine more lies.
scene yasufliers16
: Okay. That one was good.
: Teehee!
: Don’t “Teehee” at me. I need you to be as un-cute as possible so that I don’t start perceiving you as a regular girl I can groom into another lamb that I will lead to slaughter.
: I’m in a rather sensitive state right now and you’re one of the few who’s actually safe from me. Probably.
scene yasufliers17
: You are not planning on slaughtering Touka, are you? Because I love her and I want to save her.
: Not intentionally at least. But if things keep progressing the way they did the last time I hung out in her room, it’s only a matter of time.
: What happened then?
: Something something throne ascension.
: But you have not yet built your throne. You must first devote yourself to Him. It is only then that you may engage in the act of transference.
: Yasu, I have some very bad news for you.
scene yasufliers18
: I have already heard. There will be new houses here soon, and I will have to make one more pilgrimage this far outside His area of influence.
: Okay, good. Because that’s exactly what I was going to say and I’m glad we’re on the same page.
: I understand more than you think, Sensei.
: You sure do, Yasu. Just not in a way that I think you’re entirely conscious of.
: My consciousness is questionable in the first place, for my existence hinges entirely on His. Making me little more than a mite in the scales of Catherine.
: Who the hell is Catherine?
: A friend of Miss Imai’s.
: Oh great. One more girl who’s destined to fall for me.
: That would be a sin so great that not even He could save you.
: Now, I don’t want to just assume your god is racist. But based on context clues, I think I kind of have to now.
: God does not see color.
: Then why do you have a dress code that varies season by season?
scene yasufliers19
: To optimize how much of Him I can absorb, of course.
: But...it goes by-
: It’s all for the sake of absorption.
: Among other things.
scene black
: Right...
: Anyway, the market is just over here...
scene yasufliers20
Yasu hands me her stack of fliers before approaching a vendor and beginning her spiel.

I accept them begrudgingly (mostly because I wanted to actually buy a few things for the house while I’m here and I require my arms to do that), but I decide against interjecting until Yasu’s been properly rejected.
Which she will be, because she’s a lunatic.
But I’m also a lunatic. And one who hallucinates strange creatures while talking to myself and breaking some of the most heinous laws out there — only to be rewarded for doing so with fresh meat.
So maybe a success isn’t entirely out of the cards after all.
: Hello. I’m Yasu Yasui — an angel in training. Can you spare a moment of your time to talk about our lord and savior?
The vendor is an old man — one who barely makes a noise, clinging to what little life he’s got left in him by spending his days selling spices and teas.

He gazes up at Yasu as his spine, contorted by age, makes her several inches taller than him. But his eyes are not filled with curiosity toward her cause, nor do they linger longer than they’re supposed to on her body.
They hone in on her flier — picking up key words and trying to make sense of the images despite them very likely meaning absolutely nothing to anyone outside Yasu’s circle of one.
He shrugs the flier off and turns his back to Yasu, but she speaks out before he’s able to go into hiding behind stacks of cardboard boxes.
scene yasufliers21
: He will rip you into a million tiny pieces if you do not heed my call.
scene yasufliers22
Not knowing which “He” Yasu is referring to, the man quickly looks at me and recoils- stepping backward and knocking over several crates of spices.
: Yasu, don’t say “He” when I’m with you. People are going to assume you’re talking about me.
: Also, don’t threaten old people with the powers of your god. It’s bad manners.
: I will try to remember that, but my mind is a sea of trees planted by His hand only, and there is not much room left for you to sow your seed.
: Again, I have no intention of “sowing my seed” anywhere near you.
Unless she just happens to be in the room when I eventually have sex with Touka. Which she probably will be since the two of them are mostly inseparable.
scene yasufliers23
: I will start over then!
scene black
: Can you spare a moment of your time in exchange for a better life?
I follow Yasu around until she’s spoken to every vendor at every stall in the market.
There aren’t many of them, but I’ve noticed over time that new ones are appearing.
Once again, it’s like the town moves.
But the people in it, us...we remain mostly still.
There are those like Ami who face terrible hardships and somehow manage to crawl out of them.
Then there are people like me who face similar things, yet struggle greatly when it comes to going back to normal.
But I guess there are also people like Yasu.
People who do move.
She’s making a stride with whatever this is.
I can tell it’s hard for her.
But I can also tell it’s failing...
And that makes separating from her after we leave the market so much harder as I know she has so much more of that failure ahead of her.
But she doesn’t seem perturbed in the slightest.
She smiles, clutching her fliers close to her chest, and says to me before leaving-
“They will come when they have to.”
“I just know it.”
We part ways, but her words remain with me.
I don’t think mine ever stuck to her.
